notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with The Cub - Deluxe Edition and many other titles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation and you get to purchase our games, The Cub - Deluxe Edition included, at deep discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 About The Cub - Deluxe Edition

Play as The Cub and embark on a journey across a neon-lit apocalypse Earth, filled with stories and clues, only to have it interrupted when the hunt for you begins.
Explore the ruins of humanity after the Great Ecological Catastrophe in a world brought to you by the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Accompanied by Radio Nostalgia from Mars, filled with great tracks and captivating stories, The Cub offers an immersive gaming experience.

Deluxe Edition includes:

 The Cub

 The Cub Soundtrack
immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with this musical masterpiece: enjoy a whole variety of tracks written and co-composed with many artists including Igor Simic, who is the writer and director of the game itself.

Wanna crank up those nostalgia vibes even further? Check out The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle! A ruined Earth won’t ruin your fun in this package!

In Golf Club Nostalgia, return to a desolate Earth for a few rounds of golf. After all, that’s what rich people do right? Listen to the sounds of Radio Nostalgia and piece together just what happened to the people of this once prosperous planet. 

The Cub is a 2D platforming adventure that continues the story of Golf Club Nostalgia. As a child hunted by the former inhabitants of Earth, you must evade capture and return home. Run, jump, crouch and slide your way out of trouble.  Use your environment to your advantage. After all, this is your home now. 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38057/The_Cub__Golf_Club_Nostalgia/

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with The Cub - Deluxe Edition:

notes.title: Connecting Worlds
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/eaa619f3ed67ca9c2c0738c64101d5420f5f19bc.png
Welcome to the Connecting Worlds series, where our main objective is to showcase the creation of The Cub's world, delving into the primary design goals and the topics we aim to explore within this presented universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/8490b390c438b93699843281b2b2d90ee5498840.png
You might wonder how difficult was it to adapt a world used as a golfing course into a challenging parkour arena. 

TL;DR version would be: “The world primarily evolved practically”.

And if you want to dive deeper you need to know that the buildings and monuments which were mostly in the background in Golf Club Nostalgia are now integral parts of the level design that the Cub runs across, climbs, etc. This means that the urban ruins must simultaneously be beautiful and legible, feel organic, but also function as clear obstacles for a platformer. In many ways this was the main challenge and required a lot of testing and trying because it depends on the feel and flow, unlike Golf Club Nostalgia, which is basically turn-based: you hit the ball, the character automatically goes to the next spot, and you swing again. 

The Cub is free in the world, and we wanted him to physically walk and touch monuments and buildings that were once mere background decorations in Golf Club Nostalgia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/fe9e9b6ddc8383ace3fd269efbfe7f94c0785be1.png

notes.title: The Cub Soudtrack Details and Preview | Track 1 "The Son of No One"
notes.content:
Hi there!

So we recently announced The Cub and have been getting quite a few questions about the song in our trailer. Well, ask no more. Here is the track in full!

[previewyoutube=aR4Ahn0uPOc;full][/previewyoutube]

It's a custom track made especially for the game and is just the tip of the iceberg that will be The Cub's soundtrack. Just like in their previous title Golf Club: Wasteland, developers Demagog Studio will be bringing you a custom radio show with hours of apocalypse wave tracks and heartfelt stories from callers living on Mars to keep you company. Radio Nostalgia From Mars is back!

We're also going to translate and subtitle all the radio content, from song lyrics right through to the stories in other languages so you get a better sense of the hidden gems layered into the tunes and recollections of those still alive on Mars.

Also, for those wondering also how this all connects with Golf Club: Wasteland:

The game is set in the same world as Golf Club: Wasteland, but this isn’t a copy-paste sequel. We’re going back to the world we created using it to tell new stories from the perspective of a survivor on Earth. We’ve also written it in such a way that the story in The Cub intersects with the one in Golf Club: Wasteland and then continues on for those who wanted to know the fate of the golfer and the child. - Igor Simic, Creative Director, Demagog Studio

That's it for now. Thanks for reading and if you haven't already, please do give us a follow and wishlist here. It appeases the mighty Gabe and his Steam algorithm every time you do also more people who might actually like our game end up seeing it somewhere along the line. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/

Over and out!

- Team Demagog and Untold Tales
